win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 8 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

scatters.name: ARM THE CATAPULTS
scatters.behavior:
Trigger the ARM THE CATAPULTS bonus game with 10 free spins by landing 4 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 Base game mechanics are followed and there is a higher chance of landing the Catapult symbol.

 Landing 3 BONUS symbols at the same time in the bonus game awards +5 free spins.

scatters.name: SIEGE COMMAND
scatters.behavior:
Trigger the SIEGE COMMAND bonus game with 10 free spins by landing 5 BONUS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 Base game mechanics are followed and there is a higher chance of landing the Catapult symbol. Highlighted squares remain highlighted throughout the whole bonus.

 Landing 3 BONUS symbols at the same time in the bonus game awards +5 free spins.

multipliers.name: CATAPULT FEATURE
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted.

 If there is a Catapult symbol on the grid it will activate any highlighted squares after winning combinations have been awarded.

 The Catapult symbol activates only if there have been winning combinations in the current spin.

 When activated, squares will reveal Multiplier Bomb symbols. All Multiplier Bombs will then explode and reveal a multiplier which is added to a total multiplier one by one from top to bottom, left to right.

 Multiplier Bombs can either be additive or multiplicative. Additive Bombs add their value to the total multiplier, while multiplicative Bombs multiply the value of the total multiplier.

 There are four different Multiplier Bombs:

multipliers.name: Golden Multiplier Bomb
multipliers.behavior:
Golden Multiplier Bombs are multiplicative and can have one of the following multipliers: x2, x3, x5 or x10.

 Once all Bombs are revealed, the total multiplier amount will be used to multiply the value of the Tumble Win and the new Tumble Win value is then awarded.

specials.name: TUMBLE WIN
specials.behavior:
All wins are added to the total Tumble Win above the grid. After adding the win amount to the Tumble Win, all winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in to take their place and possibly award additional wins.

 The total Tumble Win amount is awarded at the end of every spin.

specials.name: Medium-Value Bombs
specials.behavior: Medium-Value Bombs are additive and can have one of the following multipliers: 10x, 15x, 20x or 25x.

specials.name: High-Value Bombs
specials.behavior: High-Value Bombs are additive and can have one of the following multipliers: 50x, 75x or 100x.
